title: Ariane 5 was lost to an overflowing number
body: In 1996 the first Ariane 5 veered off course and self-destructed about 40 seconds after launch. Software reused from Ariane 4 converted a 64-bit velocity value into a 16-bit integer that overflowed, because the new rocket flew a faster trajectory the old code had never seen. Reuse without re-checking assumptions was the real fault.
